claims.scope: HypoVault first deposit share minting against pre-set totalSupply

preconditions.text: The HypoVault constructor sets totalSupply to 1,000,000 without minting any shares.; balanceOf is initialized as an empty mapping, so the sum of balances is 0.; The first deposit is 1,000 assets.
preconditions.derivation: 未能生成忠实的形式化前提。

safety.text: The sum of all balances must equal totalSupply as required by the ERC-20 specification.; Shares minted on deposit should be proportional to deposited assets and not inflated by unbacked pre-minted supply.
safety.derivation: 未能为该影响生成忠实的安全关系。
